title: Electromagnetic Gravitation
definition: Electromagnetic gravitation refers to theoretical and phenomenological intersections where electromagnetic fields interact with or mimic gravitational effects, governed by general relativity, electrodynamics, and unified field theories.
importanceInUpsc: Tested under Science and Technology (Physics/Cosmic Physics) in Prelims for fundamental physics principles and in Mains for advanced technological applications, space research, and India's scientific missions.
learningOutcomes: Master foundational concepts and mechanisms of Electromagnetic Gravitation.
